additional_context: source/languages.html is current build source: source/hierarchy.xml lists it as the Multi-Language Support page and source/documentation.html links to it. A relevant #argonaut > Language Zulip thread records the same locale/narrative concern and pop-up outcome. Searches found no direct Confluence reference and no later FHIR-core Jira or community evidence that reverses the clarification.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current source already states that the choice of locale from Accept-language headers MAY change resource narrative syntax, including date and number formats, so additional source edits would be redundant or editorial only.
